title: What do you this of our game's style?
author: GrayMansion_Dev
selftext:
We're currently developing Crimson Temple — FPS game with some deckbuilding mechanics. We've recently switched to 3D and currently we're experimenting with the new style

We're using AI to generate 3D models and textures for them, and for me it looks kinda good, but I'd love to hear any thoughts on it

What do you think? Any feedback is appreciated

comments.author: 4moves
comments.body: Too early to tell. Lighting and placing will set the tone. Right now it looks like basic materials.

replies.author: GrayMansion_Dev
replies.body: Thanks for feedback. I got you, so it doesn't look bad right now at least? I think I'll post again once I'm done with lighting

comments.author: Bishopped
comments.body: There is no style. It looks like development placeholder stuff.

replies.author: GrayMansion_Dev
replies.body: Fair point. This is still an early stage, and we haven't done the proper lighting yet. What do you think about the models themselves? Textures look bad, models are weird or something else?

replies.author: prettyfuckingfarfrom
replies.body:
Man, do it all at the same time. What if you spend 100 hours on props, and then start on lighting and realize you need to change the props? 

Save yourself time and effort and do it all concurrently

replies.author: Bishopped
replies.body: They look like placeholder free assets. There's nothing to comment on yet man.

comments.author: kadz02
comments.body: Dawg looks like graphics from back in 2002

comments.author: mechatui
comments.body: Not consistent looks like placeholder assets

comments.author: Nicstar543
comments.body: I will never understand the pure absence of thought in some of these ai game dev posts. Like you’re asking us about the style of your game that’s completely greyscale with nothing telling going on other than barrels and a wagon? How do you even expect to get feedback from absolutely nothing? Especially considering ai development, it would take anyone else 30 minutes to make this exact same “style” with ai, so what are you asking us about?
